handedness: three.js right-handed. Converted from Unity left-handed: position/vertex z -> -z, quaternion (x,y,z,w) -> (-x,-y,z,w), triangle winding flipped. +x east, +z south (Unity z = -z).
instanceFormat: instances.bin = float32[10*N]: px,py,pz,qx,qy,qz,qw,sx,sy,sz; scales are positive (mirrored instances use separate mesh variants with the x mirror baked in). instance_roots.bin = uint8[N] index into regions. Cell ranges [offset,count] are instance indices.

terrain.heightFormula: y = y0 + (value/65535) * sizeY ; value = R*256+G for terrain_rg.png
terrain.rows: row j is z = z0 + j*sizeZ/(height-1) (three.js z); col i is x = x0 + i*sizeX/(width-1)

depthMask.name: WaveMask
depthMask.worldSizeSource: derived: G correlates -0.999 (inverse) with the terrain over its 1500 m square; GameConfigData.worldSize itself is unreadable
depthMask.uv: u = (x + worldSize/2)/worldSize, v = (z_unity + worldSize/2)/worldSize as in the game; in the png row 0 = v 1 = most negative three.js z, col 0 = most negative x
depthMask.channels: G = depth (0 shallow..255 deep), A = wave steepness, R/B see game

landmask.pixel: pixel (i,j) covers x in [x0+i*res, +res), z in [z0+j*res, +res) (three.js); row 0 = min z

source.method: non-trigger Mesh/Box/Sphere/Capsule colliders under the static roots (docks included) on layers the Player layer collides with (CollidesWithPlayer*, Ice) that straddle y=0; mesh colliders: union of the parts of their triangles at y>=0 projected to XZ. Ice blocks only stop a boat without the Icebreaker.
